idea: Build an "Egyptian-row" family. Stack horizontal rows where row i holds c_i squares of side 1/c_i, so each full row contributes exactly 1 to the sum and Σ1/c_i ≤ 1. Choose the vectors (c_i) by enumerating Egyptian-fraction decompositions with Σc_i close to n. Fill the leftover strip of height 1−Σ1/c_i with the transposed version of the same construction, recursing two levels, and zero-pad or delete to reach exactly n.
